func TestIssue4818_MethodNotAllowedLookupDoesNotPanic(t *testing.T) {
	router := New()
	router.HandleMethodNotAllowed = true
	handler := func(c *Context) {}

	router.OPTIONS("/:p0/:p1/a/:p2", handler)
	router.GET("/:p0/:p1/a/:p2", handler)
	router.PATCH("/b/:p0/:p1/c", handler)
	router.DELETE("/b/:p0/:p1/d/:p3", handler)
	router.GET("/b/:p0/:p1/e/f", handler)
	router.POST("/b/:p0/:p1/g/:p4/h", handler)
	router.OPTIONS("/b/:p0/:p1/g/:p4/h", handler)
	router.DELETE("/b/cache", handler)
	router.GET("/b/clients/:p1/g", handler)
	router.POST("/b/clients/:p1/g", handler)
	router.PATCH("/b/clients/:p1/g/:p4", handler)
	router.OPTIONS("/b/clients/:p1/g/:p4", handler)

	var w *httptest.ResponseRecorder
	assert.NotPanics(t, func() {
		w = PerformRequest(router, http.MethodPost, "/b/clients/42")
	})
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNotFound, w.Code)
}
